rows.question_masked: I clicked a link in a suspicious email and typed my password. What should I do?

response.answer: Disconnect from the network (turn off wifi or unplug the cable) without shutting down your laptop. Then call SecOps immediately on ext. 7333 and raise a Security ticket. After that, change your password from a different, trusted device.

rows.question_masked: My mailbox is full and I can't send emails

response.answer: Your mailbox quota is 50 GB. When it reaches 50 GB, sending emails stops. You will get a warning at 49 GB. Use the Online Archive to move older mail and free up space.

rows.question_masked: How do I connect to the VPN from home?

response.answer: To connect to the VPN from home, install ZenTunnel Agent 3.x from the Company Portal on Windows 11 or macOS 14+. The gateway zt-gw.vectralogistics.example is selected automatically after sign-in. Sign in with single sign-on (SSO) and approve the MFA prompt.
